This compilation captures the pure adrenaline of Monster Jam, where rivalries are settled and legends like the Anderson family fight to stay at the top of the leaderboard.

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.desc: Relive the most jaw-dropping highlights from Part 1 of the 2025 Monster Jam season compilation, featuring elite athletes pushing their machines to the limit in iconic arenas from Greensboro to Chicagoland. From the high-speed intensity of head-to-head Racing to the technical mastery required for a "maximum moonwalk," every moment is a masterclass in raw horsepower. Fans witness the ultimate high-stakes maneuver as drivers like Matt Cody and Briana Mahon brave the legendary Morgan and Morgan backflip ramp in pursuit of freestyle glory. With Grave Diggers "resurrected from the pits" and spectacular "puppy flips" electrifying the crowd, this episode captures the fearless spirit of the world's premier monster truck tour.

programme.title: Monster Jam Replay
programme.desc: Monster Jam Replay arrives at the InTrustBank Arena in Wichita, Kansas, for a pivotal Round 8 of the Arena Championship Series West. The stakes are higher than ever as the top two drivers in the series—Blake Granger and Armando Castro—face off in a high-pressure JCB Racing matchup that could shift the season leaderboard. Fans are treated to the technical brilliance of the Two Wheel Skills Challenge, featuring daring combos and gravity-defying maneuvers from the likes of Matt Cody in Grave Digger and Tim Hall Jr. in Jurassic Attack. The evening reaches a fever pitch during the Freestyle segment, where "Daredevil Diva" Angelina Nock takes Megalodon to the skies and Cliff Turner hunts for a breakthrough performance in Velociraptor. Witness the passion and raw power as these elite athletes push their 12,000-pound machines to the absolute edge for the Wichita crowd.

programme.title: Monster Jam Replay
programme.desc: The high-octane energy of Monster Jam ignites Hartford, Connecticut, as the superstars of the Arena Championship Series East descend upon People's Bank Arena. Rivalries reach a boiling point when the Robbins brothers, Montana and Triton, face off in a high-stakes "family affair" at the starting line, while points leader Jon Zimmer Jr. in Terminal Velocity battles to defend his top spot against the "fastest in the field," Coty Saucier in Dragon. Fans are treated to a masterclass in precision and raw power across three grueling competitions: the high-speed JCB Racing, the gravity-defying Two-Wheel Skills Challenge, and a chaotic Freestyle Challenge. With every point crucial for the series leaderboard, legends like Krysten Anderson in Grave Digger and Jon Zimmer in Megalodon must push their 12,000-pound machines to the absolute edge to claim the event championship.
